title: LINUXDRV-002: PWM sysfs reads parse buffers with `atoi()` without adding a terminating NUL after `read()`
summary: LINUXDRV-002: PWM sysfs reads parse buffers with `atoi()` without adding a terminating NUL after `read()`. sysfs does not append NUL bytes, so parsing can read stale stack data past the bytes returned. Capture the read length, reject full-buffer reads, append `buf[n] = '\0'`, and use `strtol()` with validation. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied. Current audit reconciliation: Current shared sysfs reader reserves the terminator and NUL-terminates at the actual count; original unterminated-read shape is absent. Next: focused short/full read regression evidence and verified historical closure.

resolution.evidence: 20261025074335-0b62-fix-rpio-gpio-findings/findings.md; rpio_sysfs_read_text() reads size - 1 bytes and NUL-terminates at the returned count; 'empty value read is an error', recorded runs in verification.md.
